title: Pixel-art wooden planks with grain, knots and nails
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art plank floor or wall at a chosen art resolution: staggered boards with dark gaps, highlight and shadow edges, hand-drawn grain lines, knots and nail heads, with per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for floors, decks, crates and cabin walls in 2D games.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_wood_planks.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: planks
parameters.meaning: Plank rows across the tile height.

parameters.name: boards_per_row
parameters.meaning: Boards in each plank row across the tile width (joints between them).

parameters.name: waviness
parameters.meaning: How much the grain lines bend.

parameters.name: knots
parameters.meaning: Chance of a knot in each board.

parameters.name: nails
parameters.meaning: 1 draws nail heads beside the joints, 0 leaves the boards unnailed.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Warm oak floor planks with nails and a few knots.

presets.name: dark_walnut
presets.description: Dark walnut boards, wavy grain, no nails.

presets.name: pale_birch
presets.description: Pale birch boards in narrow rows with fine straight grain.

presets.name: weathered_grey
presets.description: Weathered grey deck boards with wide gaps, many knots and rusty nails.

limits: Stylized pixel art, not a physically based wood: grain is a pattern of one-pixel lines rather than growth rings, and the light from the top left is baked into the edge colours. Boards run across the tile only, and plank rows are limited to a quarter of the art size. Nails are single dark pixels with a highlight on tall planks. Roughness and height are values per drawn class; the normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Board and joint layout at whole art pixels with wrap-around
Grain lines from level sets of row position plus periodic noise
Bevel shading with highlight and shadow rows
